title: CryoFAST™: AI-Automated Sample Screening and Data Collection in SerialEM and Smart EPU
content: In August 2024, Health Technology Innovations (HTI) released CryoFAST™ v1.0.0, a cutting-edge software designed to automate Cryo-EM sample screening and data collection for single particle analysis (SPA). CryoFAST integrates artificial intelligence models to streamline square and hole selection, enhancing efficiency and accuracy. Its backend employs advanced algorithms to automate microscope control via the SerialEM Python module [1], while its frontend offers a user-friendly browser interface for seamless operation.
